title: Ana and Luis
text:
My friend Ana is very kind. She always helps people at school. She is also funny, so we laugh a lot together. Ana is not shy. She talks to new students and makes them feel welcome.

Her brother Luis is quiet. He likes to read books alone in the library. He is very smart and he often helps me with math. Luis is calm, and he never gets angry.

questions.text: What does Ana always do at school?
Where does Luis like to read books?
Why do new students probably feel welcome with Ana?
options: She talks to them and is friendly

nervous about talking to other people
relaxed and not worried or angry

paragraph_translations: Mi amiga Ana es muy amable. Siempre ayuda a las personas en la escuela. También es graciosa, así que nos reímos mucho juntas. Ana no es tímida. Habla con los estudiantes nuevos y hace que se sientan bienvenidos.
Su hermano Luis es tranquilo. Le gusta leer libros solo en la biblioteca. Es muy listo y a menudo me ayuda con matemáticas. Luis es tranquilo y nunca se enoja.
